entry.name: jit.pix
entry.digest: Generates Jitter mop pixel processing objects from a patcher.
entry.description: The jit.pix object generates new Jitter mop objects from Gen patchers specifically for pixel processing. The patcher describes how each cell of a jit.matrix should be processed. jit.pix is exactly the same as jit.gl.pix except that all processing happens on the CPU as with standard Jitter mop objets. jit.pix always outputs a 4-plane matrix.
